title: Sleepy raccoon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#8a8f9c'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#c9cfda'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M74 68 q14 -4 12 -16 q-2 -10 -12 -8 q6 6 0 12 q-6 6 -8 4 z' fill='#7a7f8c'/>
  <path d='M76 62 q6 -3 5 -8 q-1 -4 -5 -3 q3 3 0 6 q-3 3 -4 2 z' fill='#c9cfda'/>
  <path d='M75 52 q5 -2 4 -6 q-1 -3 -4 -2 q2 3 0 5 z' fill='#5f6474'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='38' r='7' fill='#7a7f8c'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='38' r='7' fill='#7a7f8c'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='38' r='4' fill='#e8b4c0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='38' r='4' fill='#e8b4c0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#9aa0ad'/>
  <!-- mask -->
  <path d='M28 44 q10 -8 22 -8 q12 0 22 8 q-4 10 -22 10 q-18 0 -22 -10 z' fill='#4a4560'/>
  <!-- eyes closed sleepy -->
  <path d='M34 44 q6 4 12 0' stroke='#f6e58d' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 44 q6 4 12 0' stroke='#f6e58d' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#e4e8ef'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#3a3550'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 58 q5 4 10 0' stroke='#7a7f8c' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M78 30 h7 l-7 7 h7' stroke='#bfe8ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M88 18 h5 l-5 5 h5' stroke='#bfe8ff' stroke-width='1.7' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front paws -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='86' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#5f6474'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='86' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#5f6474'/>
</svg>
